dramas.title: Forced to Marry the Mafia Boss
dramas.tagline: A debt. A contract. A vow she can't break.
dramas.description: To settle a debt she never chose, she signs a one-year marriage contract with the city's most feared mafia boss: no feelings, no questions, no way out. He has never been told no. She refuses to be owned. Behind the guns and the glittering empire, the deal starts to look a lot like the real thing. 52 episodes.

dramas.title: My New Billionaire Husband
dramas.tagline: He threw her away. Now she owns the room.
dramas.description: For six years Janet Jones gave up a brilliant career to look after her husband Wesley, his parents and their daughter. Then Wesley brings his pregnant mistress home, and his family expects Janet to wait on her. She walks out with nothing except the offer a billionaire made that same morning: come back and save his company. 53 episodes.

dramas.title: He Mocked Her Crush on Him and Sent Her
dramas.tagline: He sent her to flirt with his rival as a joke. The rival had liked her all along.
dramas.description: For years Ava waited for Lucas, the football captain next door who kept her close but never chose her. Then he tells her to go flirt with the rival quarterback so his team can win. She walks a bottle of water over to Ethan, the star who turns down every girl on campus, and he takes it. 25 episodes.

dramas.title: He Treated Our Love Like a Prank
dramas.tagline: To him it was just a prank. To her, it was goodbye.
dramas.description: Joan Miller has loved Tristan, her neighbor and the star quarterback, for twelve years. When he humiliates her in front of the whole school to make the new girl laugh, and calls it just a prank, something in her goes quiet. She transfers to a university up north without telling him, and only once she is gone does Tristan understand what he threw away. 28 episodes.

dramas.title: Ever Since I Played That Game Paranormal
dramas.tagline: She asked the Pen Spirit for a boyfriend. Something answered.
dramas.description: On the night of the Ghost Festival, Yi He and her roommates play the Pen Spirit game, and she breaks its one rule: never ask more than three questions. That night a stranger visits her dreams and tells her exactly where to find him, a student at the business school. She tracks him down, and her roommates start digging into who he really is. 60 episodes.

dramas.title: One Night with the Billionaire Who Hated Women
dramas.tagline: He couldn’t stand a woman’s touch. Then she gave him a son.
dramas.description: Layla’s stepmother drugs her and tries to sell her to a wealthy creep. Running for her life, she hides in the room of Julian Sterling, a billionaire who cannot bear a woman’s touch, except hers. Ten months later Layla gives birth to his son, and her stepmother is already coming for them both. 64 episodes.
